notes.title: Saviorless 1.1.0: Available NOW!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39019599/9476ad5d7e2430ca74d0ecda9243825b7cb966e1.jpg

Saviorless 1.1.0: Dive Back In and Uncover the Secrets!
 
We're thrilled to unleash Saviorless 1.1.0, bringing a fresh wave of exploration, challenge refinement, and a touch of bug squashing.
 
Unveil the Lost Pages, Unlock the True Ending

 The mysteries of the world deepen! A brand new level select menu lets you revisit conquered territories. Seek out the hidden Lost Pages scattered throughout, the key to unlocking the game's secret ending. Prepare to delve back into the shadows and unearth the truth!

Strategic Checkpoints:  Save Your Sanity (and Time)

 No more frustration! We've implemented numerous checkpoints across the world. Now, when Antar meets his demise (because, let's face it, he will), you'll re-spawn closer to the action, minimising the backtracking blues.

Difficulty Curve Makeover: 

 We've heard your cries (and screams)! The difficulty curve has been meticulously adjusted, offering a smoother and more balanced game-play experience. Prepare for a challenge!

Steam Players Rejoice! 
We've vanquished those pesky Steam Achievement bugs! 

 No more waiting for the game to close to see your hard-earned badges. 
 Achievements now unlock as soon as you complete them. 
 Additionally, the "The Next Narrator" achievement should now unlock automatically if you've already completed all the others. Just boot up the game and witness its glorious arrival! 

 We hope you enjoy exploring the depths of Saviorless v1.1.0. 
As always, your feedback fuels our flames. Keep it coming!

PLAY NOW🎮

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39019599/cd3f7d7d208aed1c8cbc67fd76e1b94af0f2857d.jpg

Hi community,

Thanks for all your feedback & participation on our demo (even though it's been a long time). 

We are happy to announce that the cuba's first indie game Saviorless releases on April 2nd!

 Watch the trailer 
[previewyoutube=RlZwWbT6Cdg;full][/previewyoutube]
If you are curious about the Saviorless' world and the gameplay, feel free to check out the previous news (If you're OK with the spoilers)! 
https://steamcommunity.com/ogg/1438480/announcements/detail/3337744192496729530?snr=2___
https://steamcommunity.com/ogg/1438480/announcements/detail/3332115890305566515?snr=2___

https://steamcommunity.com/ogg/1438480/announcements/detail/5965606018649885420?snr=2___

If you don't want to be spoiled, let's sum it up in one sentence:

Saviorless is a stylish dark fantasy action-platformer with stunning hand-drawn art and animation.

In a word, it's Cuba's first indie masterpiece. 

Feel free to add the game to your wishlist and follow us!

notes.title: Antar's transformation
notes.content:
Upon arrival to the islands, Antar must use the destructive powers of his Savior to face the terrible threat represented by Nento and his group of hunters, now also converted into Saviors. 


 Antar's transformation into a Savior:

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40469584/849bf3dec47090203f6326af10f972e32c7e49f3.gif

Antar believes that destroying Nento might help returning the Smiling Islands to being a paradisiacal place like before.

In bonus get a glimpse at Antar's Savior concept art!

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40469584/f1116082ee7c5491f55028b62d708f08209f9d97.png

If you're intrigued about Saviorless' lore you can follow and wishlist the game! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1438480/Saviorless/
